title: Agentic Inquiry Configuration
description: Configuration schema for Agentic Inquiry document parsing and knowledge graph system

storage.description: Storage configuration with unified root and project isolation

root.description: Root directory for all persistent data (absolute or relative path)

default_project_id.description: Default project identifier used when no explicit project_id is provided to Config.for_project(). Must contain only alphanumeric characters, underscores, and hyphens.

project_id.description: Project identifier for data isolation (deprecated, use default_project_id). Must contain only alphanumeric characters, underscores, and hyphens.

backend.description: Vector storage backend selection. Empty string means unconfigured — run 'ai setup' to set.

uri.description: Legacy: Path or URI to LanceDB storage location (deprecated, use lancedb.path instead)

vector.description: Vector storage provider configuration (Provider Framework v2.4)

path.description: Path to LanceDB data directory (supports environment variable expansion)

graph.description: Graph storage provider configuration (Provider Framework v2.4)

relational.description: Relational storage provider configuration (Provider Framework v2.4)

provider.description: Relational storage backend: sqlite (default), spanner (Phase 2 - future)

path.description: Path to SQLite database file (supports environment variable expansion)

use_facade.description: Feature flag for StorageFacade migration. When true, internal services use the new StorageFacade abstraction. When false (default), services continue using LanceDBManager directly. Enables gradual migration and easy rollback.

backends.description: Named backend configurations. Each key is a backend name that can be referenced by role assignments.

vector_backend.description: Name of the backend to use for vector storage

graph_backend.description: Name of the backend to use for graph storage

events_backend.description: Name of the backend to use for event storage

file_tracker_backend_v2.description: Name of the backend to use for file tracking (v2 naming to avoid conflict)

table_prefix.description: Global prefix for table names (useful for multi-tenant deployments)

transaction_timeout.description: Connection acquisition timeout for transactions in seconds

migration_lock_timeout.description: Timeout for acquiring advisory locks during schema migrations in seconds

max_size.description: Maximum number of documents to cache

ttl_seconds.description: Time-to-live for cache entries in seconds (0 = no expiration)

default_limit.description: Default number of search results to return

max_limit.description: Maximum number of search results allowed

enabled.description: Enable deduplication of search results by file path

max_results_per_file.description: Maximum number of results to keep per file (1 = keep only highest-scoring chunk)

min_diversity_ratio.description: Minimum diversity ratio (0.0-1.0) - ratio of unique files to total results

reranker_type.description: Reranking strategy to use for hybrid search. Options: rrf (recommended, lightweight), linear_combination (weighted scores), cross_encoder (requires sentence-transformers), colbert (requires colbert-ai)

reranker_params.description: Parameters for the selected reranker (e.g., k for RRF, api_key for API-based rerankers)

fallback_to_vector.description: Fallback to vector-only search when hybrid search fails or returns no results

log_diagnostics.description: Enable diagnostic logging for hybrid search (useful for debugging)

overview_boost_factor.description: Boost factor for overview/documentation files in search results

enabled.description: Enable automatic boosting of documentation content

auto_detect.description: Auto-detect overview queries based on patterns

weights.description: Boost weights for different content types

semantic_bridge_enabled.description: Enable semantic bridge for entity discovery

relationship_types.description: Relationship types to follow during graph traversal

timeouts.description: Timeout configuration for graph operations in milliseconds

enabled.description: Enable query sanitization for full-text search

escape_special_chars.description: Escape special characters that could cause FTS syntax errors

preserve_wildcards.description: Preserve wildcards (* and ?) for pattern matching

sparse_index.description: Sparse index detection configuration for identifying when index has too few documents

threshold.description: Minimum chunks for index to be considered 'ready'. Below this, searches may return limited results.

enable_fallback.description: Enable fallback search behavior when index is sparse

default_provider.description: Default embedding provider to use. 'local' and 'local_model' are aliases for LocalModelEmbedder.

default_dimensions.description: Default embedding dimensions for all components

local_model.description: Local model embedding configuration for offline operation

model_path.description: Path to local model directory (workspace-relative or absolute)

normalize.description: Whether to normalize embeddings to unit length

ndims.description: Embedding dimensionality (auto-detected from model if null)

cache.description: Content-hash LRU cache for local embedders. Skips the model forward pass on duplicate embedding text (generated files, vendored deps, near-identical chunks across branches). Disabled automatically for server-side backends (AlloyDB / RDS) since embeddings run in-database there.

max_entries.description: Cache capacity in unique entries. Vectors are stored as numpy float32 (~1.5 KB per 384-dim entry); 10k entries ≈ 15 MB. Raise for giant monorepos with high duplication; lower on memory-constrained hosts. Set to 0 to disable (same as enabled=false).

total.description: Fixed timeout in seconds (used if > 0, otherwise dynamic)

per_file.description: Seconds allowed per file for dynamic timeout calculation

base.description: Base seconds for setup/flush in dynamic timeout calculation

schema_mapping.description: Schema mapping configuration for field name transformations

enabled.description: Enable schema mapping (for future compatibility if field names change)

field_mappings.description: Field name mappings from ParserChunk to database schema (parser_field: db_field)

schema_validation.description: Schema validation configuration for pre-flight checks

enabled.description: Enable pre-flight schema validation before database writes

strict_mode.description: Strict mode: fail on extra fields not in schema

cache_schemas.description: Cache table schemas to avoid repeated lookups

impact_default_depth.description: Default traversal depth for relationship analysis

processing_semaphore_limit.description: Maximum number of concurrent document processing operations. Lower values reduce memory usage, higher values increase throughput. Recommended: 5-10 for development, 10-20 for CI/CD, 20-50 for production. Raised from 10 → 20 after PR #134 batched per-file embedding; the embedding executor now releases fast enough that file-level concurrency is usable rather than queuing on a starved executor.

max_chunk_content_size.description: Maximum chunk content size in characters. Oversized chunks are split into sub-chunks. 0 = no limit. Must be >= 100 when enabled.

relationship_flush.description: Relationship flush configuration for batched relationship resolution

batch_size.description: Number of relationships to process per batch

max_concurrent_batches.description: Maximum number of concurrent batch operations (semaphore limit)

progress_log_interval.description: Log progress every N relationships processed

batch_commit_interval.description: Commit to database every N relationships

auto_flush_threshold.description: Trigger automatic flush when pending relationships exceed this threshold

flush_timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time for flush operation in seconds

external_entity_flush_threshold.description: Flush external entities when queue exceeds this threshold

enable_cache_prewarming.description: Pre-populate cache with common stdlib/builtin imports

slow_operation_threshold_ms.description: Log warning if operation exceeds this threshold (milliseconds)

max_file_size.description: Maximum file size in bytes (files larger than this are skipped)

whole_file_max_chars.description: Files at or under this size stay one chunk. Zero disables whole-file mode.

context_manager.description: Context manager configuration (manages memory contexts lifecycle)

max_concurrent_contexts.description: Maximum number of concurrent memory contexts

cleanup_interval.description: Interval in seconds between context cleanup runs

context_ttl.description: Time-to-live for contexts in seconds (idle contexts are cleaned up)

capacity.description: Maximum number of items to keep in working memory

eviction_policy.description: Eviction policy when capacity is reached

capacity.description: Maximum number of events per agent

table_name.description: LanceDB table name for episodic memories

capacity.description: Maximum number of facts per agent

table_name.description: LanceDB table name for semantic memories

episodic_threshold.description: Importance threshold for working → episodic promotion

semantic_threshold.description: Importance threshold for episodic → semantic promotion

ranking_weights.description: Ranking weights for adaptive strategy (must sum to 1.0)

auto_threshold.description: Auto-use content as summary if below this character count

queue_max_size.description: Maximum number of events to queue in memory before applying backpressure

batch_size.description: Number of events to batch together for database writes

flush_interval_seconds.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait before flushing a partial batch

retention_days.description: Number of days to retain events before cleanup

cleanup_interval_hours.description: Interval in hours between automatic cleanup operations

sampling_enabled.description: Enable sampling when queue is full (preserves failed events, samples routine progress)

sampling_ratio.description: Sampling ratio when enabled (keep 1 in N events)

retry_max_attempts.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for failed EventStore writes

retry_base_delay_seconds.description: Base delay in seconds for exponential backoff (delay = base_delay * 2^(retry_count - 1))

drop_alert_threshold.description: Alert threshold for dropped events - log error when dropped event count exceeds this threshold

progress.description: Progress indicator configuration for long-running operations

enabled.description: Enable progress event emission during long-running operations

emit_interval.description: Emit progress events every N files during indexing

min_duration.description: Minimum operation duration (seconds) to emit progress events

token_budget.description: Token budget management for context building

default_budget.description: Default token budget for context building

focus_allocations.description: Focus allocation strategies for distributing tokens between code and documentation

directory.description: Directory for log files (workspace-relative or absolute)

max_bytes.description: Maximum size per log file in bytes

backup_count.description: Number of backup files to keep during rotation

retention_hours.description: Retention period in hours (files older than this are deleted)

default_depth.description: Default traversal depth for relationship analysis

connectors.description: Connectors configuration for content source abstraction

root.description: Root directory for file enumeration (null = cwd)

ignore_patterns.description: Glob patterns for files to ignore

binary_extensions.description: File extensions to treat as binary

max_size.description: Maximum cache size in bytes (0 = unlimited)

maintenance.description: Automatic maintenance configuration for storage optimization

cleanup_retention_minutes.description: How long to keep old versions (minutes)

estimation_model.description: Tokenizer encoding used to estimate token counts

default_budget.description: Default token budget for MCP responses

suggest_on_empty.description: Suggest alternatives when a query returns nothing

gate_enabled.description: Enable the onboard gate that blocks indexing without completed onboard documentation

days_threshold.description: Number of days before onboard documentation is considered stale

files_threshold.description: Number of changed files before onboard documentation is considered stale

commits_threshold.description: Number of commits before onboard documentation is considered stale

artifact_storage.description: Artifact storage configuration for onboard reports and documentation

gcs_bucket.description: GCS bucket name when type is 'gcs'

gcs_prefix.description: GCS key prefix for onboard artifacts

local_path.description: Local directory for onboard artifacts (relative to workspace)
